comments.story: Create your own game engine but don't use it (2017)
comments.why: Common-sense view on building your own game engine in context.
comments.text: Mike Acton has some pretty common sense views on this: [VIDEO] Basically if your making your own game engine then use the context in which you are working. If you are going to end up with something generic like Unity maybe you should just use something like Unity from the start.
